programme.title: The Last Dance: Episode 4
programme.desc: The Last Dance (Sports). In the fall of 1997, Michael Jordan and the Chicago Bulls allowed a film crew to follow them as they went for their sixth NBA title in eight seasons. That resulted in a stunning portrait of one of the sport's most iconic athletes and a celebrated team. «The Last Dance» follows the Bulls' 1997-98 season from start to finish, while also covering the rest of the chapters in Jordan's remarkable career. The 10-part docuseries follows the Jordan timeline from when he was an emerging star on his high school team to becoming a worldwide marketing force and cultural figure. The series takes its name from a phrase coined by then-Bulls coach Phil Jackson, who knew that the season would likely be the final run for the core members of that 1990s Bulls dynasty

programme.title: A Wild Year on Earth: January-February – The Year Begins (S1E1). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. Anglija, 2020. S1, Ep1
programme.desc: 2020 г. Год: 2020. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2020. S1, Ep1 «A Wild Year on Earth»…The Year Begins. The start of the year is a time of extremes across Earth. From the realm of the Polar Bear the Arctic winds plunge the Northern Hemisphere into winter. While in the tropics, animals and humans have a different response to the season | Charts the planet's most spectacular events of migration, rebirth and transformation. Over the course of a turbulent year, we witness how finely tuned creatures face the Earth's seasonal patterns. However, in the 21st Century, these patterns are becoming more extreme, less predictable and dangerously unreliable. Across the globe, we witness the drama and the spectacle. No matter what time of year it is, somewhere on Earth something miraculous is happening | Director: Karina Holden

programme.title: A Wild Year on Earth: March-April – A Time of Renewal (S1E2). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. Anglija, 2020. S1, Ep2
programme.desc: 2020 г. Год: 2020. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2020. S1, Ep2 «A Wild Year on Earth»…One of the biggest wild elephant migrations in Asia takes place in India. All over the planet, animals are looking for a mate. The feast of Easter, a symbol of rebirth, is celebrated by nearly 2 billion people. In the regions around the equator, the renewal takes place at the rate of the rains. In Australia, the last green turtles join the Great Barrier Reef islands to lay their eggs, while in Antarctica thousands of emperor penguins return to their breeding grounds | Just as humans modify their behaviour to match their own calendar of rituals, animals coordinate their physiology and anticipate changes in the environment according to what their biological clocks dictate. Aiming to explain how various species handle the rhythmic natural patterns as they grow more extreme and turbulent every year, the story takes a closer look at the planet's most extraordinary seasonal events of migration, rebirth, and transformation | Director: Karina Holden

programme.title: America's Wild Seasons: Summer (S1E2). Documentary about nature. USA, Canada, 2019. S1, Ep2
programme.desc: 2019 г. Год: 2019. Страна: JAV, Kanada. Год: 2019. S1, Ep2 «America's Wild Seasons»…Summer is the time of plenty across America. It's a chance for animals to reap nature's bounty while they can. The year's young begin to explore their world, while new parents make use of the long days to make sure they grow up strong | The wilds of America are vast and untamed. Over the course of a year, this immersive documentary series investigates the perils and challenges faced by the animals that inhabit these ferocious wildernesses. Through winter, spring, summer and autumn witness how the ever changing conditions affect life on land, below the waves and in the air. The personalities and characters of certain animals will develop as the series progress and you will find yourself rooting for your favourites to survive as the seasons go by. America's seasons are wild and extreme posing many trails to the varied wildlife that live there. From freezing rains to scorching deserts, the weather is as scary and unpredictable as it could possibly be. Nature documentary series | Director: Jeff Morales | Cast: Scott McNeil

programme.title: Coastal Africa: Sanctuary Of the Indian Ocean (S1E2). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. JAV, 2016. S1, Ep2

programme.title: National Parks – Protected natural wonders
programme.desc: Lush green mountains, barren plateaus and deep gorges characterize a barely discovered region. Transhumance, Mont Aigoual and the Aven Armand cave offer impressive natural experiences. (Station info).

programme.title: Portugal – wild and untamed
programme.desc: Central Portugal surprises with an enormous diversity of species and landscapes. Rare black storks nest in the Tagus Valley, while the Serra da Estrela mountains are home to eagle owls. (Station info).

programme.title: Tasmania – An island is upside down
programme.desc: This marsupial could only be the Tasmanian devil, according to the first settlers on Australia's largest island. It has a unique flora and fauna. Over a third are nature reserves, national parks or UNESCO world heritage sites. Rainforests, clear waters and snow-capped mountains are home to white kangaroos, diurnal wombats, giant Tasmanian freshwater crabs, ant-eating echidnas and egg-laying platypuses.

programme.title: Weapons of animals
programme.desc: Sea predators like the great white shark are armed to the teeth and their prey's options for escape are usually limited. What tactics do ocean dwellers use to ensure they don't become meals? (Station info).

programme.title: 24 hours of wilderness
programme.desc: The desert is alive. From chameleons to big cats, every animal resident reaches deep into their bag of tricks to cope with the scorching heat during the day and the bitter cold at night. (Station info).

programme.title: 24 hours of wilderness
programme.desc: The African savannah is a true paradise for predators. The vast grassland offers potential prey little protection from escaping the sharp claws of hungry cheetahs and lions. (Station info).

programme.title: 24 hours of wilderness
programme.desc: The animal jungle inhabitants lead a life in the fast lane. At night, killers as fast as an arrow hunt here, from red-eyed tree frogs to camouflaged praying mantises. (Station info).

programme.title: Veterinarian Dr. Jeff – The Rocky Mountain Doc
programme.desc: Dr. Jeff and his wife have been living in a trailer with no water connection for months. The chaos at home doesn't stop the vet from treating the dog Foxy's honey cyst. (Station info).

programme.title: Veterinarian Dr. Jeff – The Rocky Mountain Doc
programme.desc: Dr. Jeff's reputation as the "Robin Hood of veterinarians" extends far beyond Colorado's borders: Jeana traveled from Iowa, more than 1,000 kilometers away, to save her dog's leg. (Station info).

programme.title: Animal Park: Zoo Stories from Longleat
programme.desc: Ben gets a crash course in duck care from keeper Abby, while Kate makes a toy for the colobus monkeys. In Longleat, zookeepers look after the sick lion Ghost. (Station info).

programme.title: Animal Park: Zoo Stories from Longleat
programme.desc: Will the young Bactrian camel become herd leader? Thanks to wildlife filmmaker Yassin's footage, keepers are analyzing his behavior. Meanwhile, Ben visits four cute tiger cubs. (Station info).

programme.title: Zoo and stuff – wild animals: Best of
programme.desc: With only 600 left in the wild, onagers are one of the most endangered species in the world. The joy at Chester Zoo is all the greater when three of the half-donkey ladies become pregnant. (Station info).

programme.title: Animal Park: Zoo Stories from Longleat
programme.desc: For the first time in the history of Longleat Safari Park, keepers can celebrate the birth of three cheetah cubs. Meanwhile, the zoo's osteopaths are treating elephant Anne's arthritis. (Station info).

programme.title: Hautnah Zoo Visit
programme.desc: The red pandas have attracted numerous visitors and make for a crowded zoo. In the meantime, zoo operators are battling the increasing heat wave to protect the animals. (Station info).

programme.title: Hautnah Zoo Visit
programme.desc: The red kangaroo alpha male Malu has problems eating and gets help from the mobile hospital team. Meanwhile, the expected shipment of baby animals arrives at Taronga Western Plains Zoo. (Station info).

programme.title: Heroes of evolution
programme.desc: What is behind the heaviest land animals in the world? Rhinos and hippos are not only among the most impressive creatures in the animal kingdom. They also possess amazing abilities. (Station info).

programme.title: Heroes of evolution
programme.desc: There are 91 different species of antelope worldwide. 70 of them live in Africa. The annual migration of the elegant and graceful animals through the savannah is a unique natural spectacle. (Station info).

programme.title: San Diego Zoo
programme.desc: A baby red-necked wallaby at the San Diego Zoo needs special attention. Because Everest is an albino and therefore more susceptible to illnesses. Can the nurses help him? (Station info).

programme.desc: Candis seems to be the ideal koala keeper thanks to her work in Australia. Amur leopard Satka's pregnancy is causing excitement among park employees. (Station info).

programme.desc: Lauro đi về phía bắc Vòng Bắc Cực cùng với đội chó kéo xe của mình để săn tuần lộc; Daniel xây dựng lại một cabin nổi cũ bằng cách sử dụng những khúc gỗ lũa và sức mạnh của thủy triều.

programme.title: SWAMP PEOPLE S15 EP08
programme.desc: Khi mùa cá sấu đi được nửa chặng đường, Troy và Pickle săn lùng một hang mật bị ma ám với quá khứ đầy sóng gió. Bruce tìm kiếm con quái vật đang đe dọa một hố bơi ở địa phương.

programme.title: THE CURSE OF OAK ISLAND S12 EP15
programme.desc: Khi nhóm tiến gần hơn đến việc lấy lại thứ mà họ tin là Hầm Chappell, một sự kiện nguy hiểm xảy ra ở Hố Tiền và Hội phải nhanh chóng điều chỉnh kế hoạch của mình để tránh thảm họa.

programme.title: SECRETS DECLASSIFIED WITH DAVID DUCHOVNY S1 EP06
programme.desc: Từ việc CIA theo đuổi huyết thanh sự thật hoàn hảo kéo dài hàng thập kỷ cho đến PsyOps bí mật của Quân đội Hoa Kỳ tại Việt Nam, các trò chơi đấu trí từ lâu đã diễn ra giữa các quốc gia, kẻ thù và thậm chí cả công dân của họ.

programme.title: HIDDEN CITIES S1 EP03
programme.desc: Khám phá hang động nhân tạo được tạc từ dung nham nóng chảy, khu phức hợp tôn giáo Đông Java và lâu đài Hà Lan ẩn bên dưới Semarang.

programme.title: THE DEATH COAST EP07
programme.desc: Một cơn bão mạnh buộc nhóm của Jeff phải đến một vịnh nhỏ hẻo lánh, nơi họ điều tra The Lombrac, con tàu ma huyền thoại thế kỷ 18. Các thợ lặn tìm được manh mối hấp dẫn từ độ sâu âm u.

programme.title: THE UNBELIEVABLE WITH DAN AYKROYD S1 EP03
programme.desc: Những vụ đắm tàu, tai nạn và nhìn thấy UFO, ôi chao! Tập này khám phá Tam giác Hồ Michigan và những nơi khác, bao gồm một hòn đảo đầy búp bê với quá khứ đen tối và nơi bị ma ám nhất ở Hoa Kỳ.

programme.title: MOUNTAIN MEN S13 EP03
programme.desc: Lauro đi về phía bắc Vòng Bắc Cực cùng với đội chó kéo xe của mình để săn tuần lộc; Daniel xây dựng lại một cabin nổi cũ bằng cách sử dụng những khúc gỗ lũa và sức mạnh của thủy triều.
